table.name: TLGNU_PREFERENCES
table.description: Preferences table. Contains each record for every user setting, storing default settings for some screen. Default settings can be default values of dropdown lists or different search criterias, column width. Used on Order search, External Order Search, Order Monitoring, Truck Scheduling, Rail Scheduling screens.

column.name: USER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnu_user. This record contains a preference of this user.

column.name: PREFERENCE_KEY
column.description: Key to identify a user UI setting value.

column.name: VAL_STR
column.description: A value in which the user UI setting is stored, if it is of varchar2 type.

column.name: VAL_NUM
column.description: A value in which the user UI setting is stored, if it is of decimal type.

column.name: VAL_DAT
column.description: A value in which the user UI setting is stored, if it is of date type.
